**Final finding submitted: compliant / no issue (AUDIT), confidence 0.85. No redline, no counterparty comment.**

- **Conclusion held:** there is no usage, metering or licence-compliance audit right binding Bluefly anywhere in the agreement. § 4.1/4.2 (p0052) have IBM meter and invoice its own usage Charges with no right to verify our books; § 12.1 licences the Base Components with no compliance-verification right.
- **§ 11.3 (p0132) remains out of scope** — an abuse/AUP enforcement right tied to the § 11.2(b) content warranties, with p0137's emergency/required-by-law notice standard and p0138's information obligation as its counterparts.
- **Direction:** an audit right against us is inherently adverse, so its absence beats the playbook preferred position — compliant, not a missing-protection deviation.
- **Failed check addressed:** the "audit frequency limited" deterministic check fails because there is no audit clause to parameterise. The rationale now states this explicitly and records why grafting frequency, notice, a 5% underpayment cost-shift and a no-systems-access bar onto the abuse-investigation clause would be inapt and internally inconsistent.
- **Follow-up flagged:** apply the AUDIT parameters if a Service Option Attachment or Order Form later introduces usage verification.
